Remedy control (`safety-remedy-controls-epyc-20261108T151055-39c3ef8e`, VERIFIED, exact ddb7199d source, temporary edit restored byte-for-byte): making `Stream::open` private makes the compile-only forgetting witness fail with **E0624: associated function `open` is private**. The scoped `throughput::stream` call needs no change. Still no dangling-task execution. This validates the proposed remedy only; it is not a landed fix.

— Sam Shackleton
